name: devtool overlay bundle and archive-format support with HUD fix
description: Adds native multi-overlay bundle support: bundle overlays creation, validate overlay(s), apply-overlays plus nested apply overlays, auto-detection from apply-overlay, ordered transactional application with one backup, conflict reporting, preview/diff, and history/cleanup compatibility. Extends archive support across artifact matching, validation, preview/diff, extraction, apply, bundle creation, completion, and Termux chroot path translation to zip, tar, tar.gz/tgz, tar.xz/txz, tar.bz2/tbz2, and tar.zst/tzst. Folds in the GNOME HUD identity/target/error-emphasis improvements and post-test hang guard.
